decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block references from the FAQ and updates the primary-mint allocation and Small Block descriptions.
The existing same-message MODIFY already replaces the two-block prize copy with continuing Small Block prizes and excludes Big Block advertising.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the Big Block ticket from the no-referral reward components while preserving the commission and Small Block ticket.
The existing same-message MODIFY already restricts selection eligibility and scope to the remaining Small Block mechanism while preserving Chainlink VRF selection.
The existing same-message MODIFY already reduces ticket issuance and counters to Small Block and removes the obsolete Big Block eligibility-window and post-draw-action keys.
Eliminating Big Block prizes does not change the automatic wallet-transfer collection method or payout destination for the remaining Small Block prizes.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records that $5 from each primary mint funds the continuing Small Block prize pool; the established $500 draw mechanics remain unchanged.

The existing same-message MODIFY fully records the $15 split, including $5 each to the founder, affiliate, and Small Block prize pool, and removes Big Block from the destination list through replacement.
The existing same-message MODIFY already deletes the obsolete Big Block ticket-counter visibility attribute from NFT metadata.
The prize-mechanism and revenue-allocation decision does not change the Transak provider, payment methods, conversion, or NFT purchase fulfillment behavior.
The existing same-message MODIFY already removes Big Block from the royalty-funded prize-pool destinations while leaving the separately established secondary-sale royalty terms unchanged.
Eliminating Big Block prizes does not alter the approved badge set, referral milestones, badge storage, or cosmetic leaderboard role.
